description_en: Queries vulnerability count statistics by UUID
description_zh: 查询 UUID 维度的漏洞数量统计
name: DescribeUuidVulNumClassifyStatistic

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the asset. If ImageVul is set to false, specify the host UUID. If ImageVul is set to true, specify the image ID. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资产唯一标识。ImageVul 为 false 时传入主机 UUID；ImageVul 为 true 时传入镜像 ID。多个值使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query image vulnerability statistics. Valid values:
true: The Uuids parameter specifies image IDs.
false: The Uuids parameter specifies host UUIDs.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询镜像漏洞统计。取值：true：Uuids 为镜像 ID；false：Uuids 为主机 UUID。默认值：false
parameters.name: image_vul

additionalProperties.description_en: The vulnerability count statistics for a single asset
additionalProperties.description_zh: 单个资产的漏洞数量统计

AppNum.description_en: The number of application vulnerabilities. This field is 0 when ImageVul is set to true
AppNum.description_zh: 应用漏洞数量。ImageVul 为 true 时该字段为 0

CmsNum.description_en: The number of Web-CMS vulnerabilities. This field is 0 when ImageVul is set to true
CmsNum.description_zh: Web-CMS 漏洞数量。ImageVul 为 true 时该字段为 0

CveNum.description_en: The number of Linux software vulnerabilities

EmgNum.description_en: The number of emergency vulnerabilities. This field is 0 when ImageVul is set to true
EmgNum.description_zh: 应急漏洞数量。ImageVul 为 true 时该字段为 0

ScaNum.description_en: The number of software composition analysis (SCA) vulnerabilities
ScaNum.description_zh: 软件成分分析（SCA）漏洞数量

SysAsapNum.description_en: The number of high-priority system vulnerabilities among Linux software vulnerabilities and Windows system vulnerabilities
SysAsapNum.description_zh: 系统类漏洞（Linux 软件漏洞和 Windows 系统漏洞）中修复必要性为尽快修复的漏洞数量

SysNum.description_en: The number of Windows system vulnerabilities. This field is 0 when ImageVul is set to true
SysNum.description_zh: Windows 系统漏洞数量。ImageVul 为 true 时该字段为 0

VulAsapSum.description_zh: 修复必要性为尽快修复的漏洞数量

VulLaterSum.description_zh: 修复必要性为可延后修复的漏洞数量

VulNntfSum.description_zh: 修复必要性为暂可不修复的漏洞数量

Data.description_en: The vulnerability statistics returned by asset unique identifier. The key of the map is the host UUID or image ID specified in the request
Data.description_zh: 按资产唯一标识返回的漏洞统计结果。Map 的键为请求中的主机 UUID 或镜像 ID
